svg.text: Speed, lateral position and peak slip angle around one lap of Spa
Speed sits at the cap once the spawn transient decays; the car never reaches half the available width; slip stays under the 12 degree bound the whole lap.
[MEASURED] spa_curriculum.py cross_track_penalty=2.0, 40M steps, cap 13.0 m/s · scored by policy_eval.py · double-track model, rung 2 · track [SOURCED] TUMFTM/racetrack-database
